chapter.verse: Topa aw, migilote kiang panin kei hong honkhia in la, mi ngongtatte kiang panin kei hong kem in.
Amaute in a lung sung uh ah thusia geelgeel uh a, gal vive phuang ngitnget uh hi.
Amaute’ leii in gulpi leii bang a, a thugente uh gulgu bang hi.
Topa aw, migilote khut sung panin kei hong cing in la, kei, sukpuk ding a hong sawm mi ngongtatte’ kiang panin kei hong kem in.
Mi kiphasakte in kei hong siahna-in tehlop koihsim uh a, amaute in khau tawh ngenthang zak uh a, lam gei-ah thangzak tawh kei hong siah uh hi.
Topa ’ tungah hih bangin ka ci hi: Nang in keima Pasian na hi hi; keima thuumna awte hong ngai in, Topa!
Topa, keima Topa, a thahat kei hong honkhiapa aw, gal kidona sungah keimah nong hu hi.
Topa aw, migilopa’ deihnate tangtungsak kei in la, ama thusia sawmna a maban sot sak kei in!
Kei hong umcih mite, gualzosak kei in la, kei hong sawmnate uh amau’ lu tung mah tusak in!
Amaute tungah mei-am kuang zusak in! A thokik zo nawn lo dingin dum sungah amaute kia suk sak in!
Mi gensiapa leitungah kip sak kei in la, mi ngongtatpa pen thusia in sulzuih mengmeng ta hen!
Topa in a thuak mite’ thu a panpihna, mi cimawhte’ adingin thu a manin a khenna ka thei hi.
Thuman mite in nangma min hong phat pelmawh ding uh a, lungsim thutangte pen nangma omna-ah teeng ding uh hi.
